src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/__init__.py.name: Dataset downloads package
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/__init__.py.description: Marks the dataset download scripts as one package; it holds no code.

src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/common.py.name: Download helpers
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/common.py.description: Downloads files with retries and checks each one against its expected fingerprint, then saves samples.

src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_all.py.name: Download all datasets
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_all.py.description: Runs every dataset download and prints what was fetched or skipped; a skipped source never stops the others.

src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_injecag.name: InjecAgent download
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_injecag.description: Downloads the InjecAgent test cases and the 50 real attack messages the hijacked agent sends.

src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_kaggle_.name: Kaggle prompts download
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_kaggle_.description: Turns the Kaggle prompt-injection file into training rows, or skips it when it has no usable label or needs a login.

src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_netflow.name: Network traffic samples
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_netflow.description: Takes a 200,000-row sample of each downloaded network-traffic dataset; a person downloads the full files in a browser first.

src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_prompt_.name: Prompt-safety download
src/app/sentinel/_py/fetch/fetch_prompt_.description: Downloads the Hugging Face prompt-injection set Prompt Guard trains on; kept out of git because it has no licence.

src/app/sentinel/_py/make_dataset.py.name: Simulated training data
src/app/sentinel/_py/make_dataset.py.description: Simulates runs of 8 agents, labels each minute clean or one of four attacks, and writes the training set.

src/app/sentinel/_py/record_timeline.py.name: Demo recorder
src/app/sentinel/_py/record_timeline.py.description: Records a real run of the team, minute by minute, as the dashboard's offline demo, and refuses to save a run with a false alarm.
